info.title: Timezone Lookup API - Get Timezone from IP, Coordinates, IATA Code & More
info.description: Resolve any location identifier to its current timezone, local time, UTC offset, and daylight saving time details. Accepts IP addresses, GPS coordinates, city or address strings, IATA/ICAO airport codes, UN/LOCODEs, and IANA timezone names. Always returns a time_zone object (IANA name, UTC offset with/without DST, current local time in multiple formats, DST transition dates); which other object accompanies it depends entirely on the identifier used. A tz name or lat/long coordinate pair returns time_zone only, with no location breakdown at all. A location address returns a basic location object (country, region, city, coordinates). An ip parameter, or no parameter at all (client-IP fallback), returns a richer location object with continent and country codes, EU membership, and postal code, plus a top-level ip field. An iata_code or icao_code returns an airport_details object instead of location. A lo_code returns a lo_code_details object instead of location.

get.summary: Retrieve current time, date, and timezone information for any location identifier
get.description: Get current time, date, and timezone details by specifying a timezone name, location address, GPS coordinates, IP address, IATA/ICAO airport code, UN/LOCODE, or use the client IP if no parameter is provided.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to extract timezone information.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: Timezone name in IANA format (e.g., Asia/Kolkata) to retrieve information directly.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Location string (preferably city and country) to extract timezone.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude for geolocation-based timezone lookup. Only time_zone is returned for this mode; no location object is included.

parameters.name: long
parameters.description: Longitude for geolocation-based timezone lookup. Only time_zone is returned for this mode; no location object is included.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Response language for location fields. Default: en.

parameters.name: iata_code
parameters.description: 3-letter IATA airport code (e.g., LHR) to extract timezone.

parameters.name: icao_code
parameters.description: 4-letter ICAO airport code (e.g., KJFK) to extract timezone.

parameters.name: lo_code
parameters.description: 5-letter UN/LOCODE city code to extract timezone.

locationLookup.summary: Lookup by location address (location param) — basic location fields, DST active

tzNameLookup.summary: Lookup by IANA timezone name (tz param) — no location object at all; DST not observed here, so dst_start/dst_end are empty objects

ipLookup.summary: Lookup by IP address (ip param, or default client IP) — full geo-IP location fields, includes top-level ip, never location_string

airportLookup.summary: Lookup by IATA/ICAO airport code — returns airport_details instead of location

loCodeLookup.summary: Lookup by UN/LOCODE — returns lo_code_details instead of location

lo_code_details.location_type: Port, Rail Terminal, Road Terminal, Airport, Postal Exchange

400.description: Bad Request — Invalid coordinates, timezone name, IP address, or airport code

value.message: 'latitude' (999) or 'longitude' (0) is not valid. 'latitude' must be between -90.0 and +90.0 and 'longitude' must be between -180.0 and +180.0.
Check whether your input values are correct; time_zone_name = Invalid/Timezone
'999.999.999.999' is not an IP string literal.
Invalid IATA code: INVALID. IATA code must be in the format of AAA.
Invalid ICAO code: INVALID. ICAO code must be in the format of AAAA.

404.description: Not Found — Location address not found, or LO code has no matching data

value.message: We couldn't find the location (ZZZNOTEXIST). Try a city or state level location address only.
'Data not found for the provided LO code: XXXXX Please contact at support@ipgeolocation.io if provided LO code exists.'

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

ip.description: The IP address used for the timezone lookup. Present when queried using the ip parameter, or with no location-identifying parameter at all (client-IP fallback). Absent for every other lookup mode.

TimezoneResponse.description: Timezone lookup result. time_zone is always present. Exactly which other object accompanies it depends on the lookup mode: tz name and lat/long coordinates return time_zone only (no location, no ip); location address returns a basic location object; ip param or client-IP fallback returns a rich location object plus top-level ip; iata_code/icao_code returns airport_details instead of location; lo_code returns lo_code_details instead of location.

TimeZone.description: Timezone and date/time information for the location.

name.description: The IANA timezone name/identifier for the location.

offset.description: The Standard time zone offset from UTC in hours.

offset_with_dst.description: The time zone offset from UTC in hours, accounting for DST.

current_time.description: The current date and time with timezone offset in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS±ZZZZ format.

current_time_unix.description: The Unix timestamp representing the date and time in seconds.

date.description: The current date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

date_time.description: The current date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

date_time_txt.description: The current date and time in descriptive format EEEE, MMMM dd, yyyy HH:mm:ss.

date_time_wti.description: The date and time with time zone information in EEE, dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss Z format.

date_time_ymd.description: The date and time with timezone offset in ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss±HHMM.

time_24.description: The current time in 24-hour format HH:mm:ss.

time_12.description: The current time in 12-hour format with AM/PM notation.

week.description: The week number of the year (1-52).

month.description: The current month as a number (1-12).

year_abbr.description: The two-digit abbreviation for the year.

current_tz_abbreviation.description: Abbreviation of the time zone currently in effect (standard or DST).

current_tz_full_name.description: Full name of the time zone currently in effect.

standard_tz_abbreviation.description: Abbreviation of the standard (non-DST) time zone.

standard_tz_full_name.description: Full name of the standard (non-DST) time zone.

is_dst.description: Is the time zone in daylight savings?

dst_tz_abbreviation.description: Abbreviation of the DST time zone. Always present as a key; holds an empty string when dst_exists is false.

dst_tz_full_name.description: Full name of the DST time zone. Always present as a key; holds an empty string when dst_exists is false.

dst_savings.description: The amount of time added for daylight saving in hours.

dst_exists.description: Indicates whether DST is observed in the region.

DstTransition.description: DST transition details (used for both the DST start and DST end transitions). Always present as a key on the parent TimeZone object; returned as an empty object {} when dst_exists is false, so none of its properties are required.

duration.description: Clock change at the DST transition, in hours.

gap.description: true if local time jumps forward (some times do not exist).

date_time_after.description: Local date/time immediately after the DST transition.

date_time_before.description: Local date/time immediately before the DST transition.

overlap.description: true if local times repeat around the DST transition.

TimezoneLocation.description: Geographic location information. Only present for location (address) and ip (or client-IP fallback) lookups; absent for tz, lat/long, iata_code/icao_code, and lo_code lookups. Field set varies by mode: location returns location_string plus a basic field set (country_name, state_prov, city, locality, latitude, longitude); ip/default returns a richer geo-IP field set (continent_code, continent_name, country_code2, country_code3, country_name_official, is_eu, state_code, district, zipcode) plus the common fields, but never location_string or locality.

location_string.description: The provided location parameter as location. Present only for location (address) lookups; absent for ip lookups.

continent_code.description: The two-letter code of the continent (e.g., NA). Geo-IP field only: present for ip param or default client-IP lookups; absent for location lookups.

continent_name.description: The full name of the continent (e.g., North America). Geo-IP field only: present for ip param or default client-IP lookups; absent for location lookups.

country_code2.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 two-letter country code (e.g., US). Geo-IP field only: present for ip param or default client-IP lookups; absent for location lookups.

country_code3.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code (e.g., USA). Geo-IP field only: present for ip param or default client-IP lookups; absent for location lookups.

country_name.description: The common name of the country (e.g., United States). Present for both location and ip lookups.

country_name_official.description: The official full name of the country (e.g., United States of America). Geo-IP field only: present for ip param or default client-IP lookups; absent for location lookups.

is_eu.description: Whether the country belongs to the European Union. Geo-IP field only: present for ip param or default client-IP lookups; absent for location lookups.

state_prov.description: Name of the state/province/region. Present for both location and ip lookups.

state_code.description: Code of the state/province/region. Geo-IP field only: present for ip param or default client-IP lookups; absent for location lookups.

district.description: Name of the district or county. Geo-IP field only: present for ip param or default client-IP lookups; absent for location lookups.

city.description: Name of the city. Present for both location and ip lookups.

locality.description: Smaller area, part or region of a city. Only present for location (address) lookups (may be an empty string); absent for ip lookups.

zipcode.description: ZIP/Postal code of the place. Geo-IP field only: present for ip param or default client-IP lookups; absent for location lookups.

latitude.description: The geographic latitude of the location. Present for both location and ip lookups.

longitude.description: The geographic longitude of the location. Present for both location and ip lookups.

AirportDetail.description: Airport information, present when queried by IATA or ICAO code.

type.description: Classification of the airport based on size and traffic.

name.description: The full name of the airport.

latitude.description: The latitude coordinate of the airport.

longitude.description: The longitude coordinate of the airport.

elevation_ft.description: The elevation of the airport above sea level, measured in feet.

continent_code.description: The two-letter code of the continent.

country_code.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code for the country where the airport is located.

state_code.description: Code of the state/province/region where the airport is located.

city.description: The city or administrative region that the airport serves.

iata_code.description: The three-letter IATA airport code (e.g., LHR).

icao_code.description: The four-letter ICAO airport code (e.g., EGLL).

faa_code.description: The FAA location identifier, used primarily in the United States.

LoCodeDetail.description: UN/LOCODE location details, present when queried by LO code.

lo_code.description: A unique identifier for the location, often used in logistics and shipping (e.g., USNYC).

city.description: The name of the city or location associated with the LO code.

state_code.description: The code for the state, province or region.

country_code.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., US).

country_name.description: The name of the country in an administrative context.

location_type.description: The type of location as comma-separated list of facilities (e.g., Port, Rail Terminal, Road Terminal, Airport).

latitude.description: The latitude coordinate of the location.

longitude.description: The longitude coordinate of the location.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.
